title: Jack Rabbit Rachael Rabbit Orange, Mango and Passionfruit E-Liquid Shortfill 100ml
description: Rachael Rabbit's Orange, Mango and Passionfruit shortfill crafts a tropical symphony, blending the zesty brightness of orange with the creamy sweetness of mango and the exotic tartness of passionfruit. This e-liquid concocts a luscious cocktail of sun-drenched flavours, where the lively citrus of the orange beautifully complements the mango's richness and the sharp, aromatic allure of passionfruit. A dash of ice adds a refreshing layer, creating a vape that's both invigorating and perfectly balanced, with a crisp, clean finish. Presented in a 120ml shortfill bottle, this e-liquid includes 100ml of vape juice, providing space for 2 x 10ml nicotine shots. Adding 2 x 10ml, 18mg nicotine shots results in 120ml of 3mg e-liquid, giving you the flexibility to adjust nicotine strength as desired. Its 70VG/30PG composition is ideal for sub-ohm vaping, ensuring a harmonious balance of intense flavour and voluminous vapour with high-powered setups. Opting for Rachael Rabbit shortfills offers vapers an economical way to enjoy premium flavours, with the added benefit of customising nicotine content. These e-liquids are especially suited for advanced sub-ohm devices, designed to meet the needs of vapers who prefer a more intense vaping experience. Made with pride in the UK, Rachael Rabbit is renowned for its complex fruit medleys. Each e-liquid showcases a trio of distinct flavours, providing layered and authentic-tasting fruit vapes that stand out for their depth and originality.
